empty.heading: No environments yet
empty.body: Bayplan can manage the Docker host it runs on through the Docker socket. Start Bayplan with the socket mounted, then add the host in Settings. Remote hosts will be available in a later release.
empty.noPermission: Ask an admin to add a Docker host.

detected.heading: Manage this Docker host?
detected.body: Bayplan found Docker on {{name}} and can manage it through the socket.

localHost.notice: Managing a host through the Docker socket gives Bayplan, and any admin who signs in here, root-equivalent control of that host.
localHost.workerNotice: This host is a swarm worker. Pin Bayplan to a manager node to manage the swarm. Bayplan will show node-local data only.

unsupported.body: {{engine}} {{version}} (API {{api}}) isn't supported. Bayplan needs Docker Engine 24 or later.
unsupported.podman: Podman {{version}} detected. Bayplan manages Docker Engine only.
unsupported.addHelper: It will appear as unsupported, with no operations available.

unreachable.heading: Docker isn't answering
unreachable.body: Bayplan found a Docker socket at {{path}}, but Docker didn't answer. Check that Docker is running and that Bayplan is allowed to open the socket, then check again.

notDetected.heading: No Docker socket found
notDetected.body: Bayplan didn't find a Docker socket at {{path}}. To manage this host, start Bayplan with the socket mounted:
notDetected.footnote: Remote hosts will be available in a later release.
